note: Tool schemas and argument aliases as in main+#27 before 4d (snapshot for the baseline).

tools.name: calculate
tools.description: Exact maths and unit conversion, e.g. '12*7', '15% * 80', '5 km in mi', '70 F in C'.

tools.name: weather
tools.description: Current weather and forecast for a place.

days.description: Days of forecast from today, 1 to 7

tools.name: wikipedia
tools.description: Short encyclopedia summary about a person, place or thing.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web for current or detailed information. Hain then reads the best pages for you.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Read the text of one web page, e.g. a link from the user.

url.description: The full address, starting with https://

tools.name: set_alarm
tools.description: Prepare an alarm clock on the phone. The user confirms it on a card.

label.description: Optional short text for the alarm

tools.name: set_timer
tools.description: Prepare a countdown timer on the phone. The user confirms it on a card.

seconds.description: Length in seconds, e.g. 600 for 10 minutes

label.description: Optional short text for the timer

tools.name: add_calendar_event
tools.description: Prepare a calendar event. Opens the calendar app filled in after the user confirms.

title.description: What the event is, e.g. Zahnarzt

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Prepare a route to a place in the user's map app. The user confirms it on a card.

destination.description: Place or address, e.g. Kölner Dom

mode.description: Optional: walk, drive, bike or transit
